content_sections.heading: Allahabad University Faculty Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Allahabad University Faculty Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Allahabad University Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment drive is being conducted by Allahabad University for filling various faculty and professional expert positions under the B.A.LL.B.(Hons) Five Year Integrated Course.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this notification?
faq.answer: The posts available are Faculty and Professional Experts for B.A.LL.B.(Hons) Five Year Integrated Course under the Faculty of Law.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies available across different categories for Faculty and Professional Expert roles at Allahabad University.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The mode of application is purely through Walk-in-Interview. Eligible candidates must report directly to the designated venue on the scheduled interview date.

faq.question: Q5. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to take place on 14 October 2026 at the New Building of the Faculty of Law, University of Allahabad.

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualification required for Faculty posts?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for Faculty positions must possess qualifications as per the UGC Regulations, 2018 for appointment of teachers in higher education.

faq.question: Q7. What is the qualification required for Professional Experts?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for Professional Expert positions must have a minimum of 10 years of practice in Law.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for Faculty positions?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Faculty position will receive a fixed salary amount of Rs. 45,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q9. What is the remuneration for Professional Experts?
faq.answer: Professional Experts will receive Rs. 1,500/- per lecture, subject to a maximum limit of Rs. 50,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q10. Where can candidates download the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates can download the official application form and notification details directly from the official website of Allahabad University at www.allduniv.ac.in.
